title: Packet mods: off by default, the sample mod through the real packet seams

steps.say: Load the sample mod and push a packet stream through the client's length table and handler table, with mods off and on. Needs the sample built: dotnet build docs/modding/samples/announce/Announce.csproj.

do.text: Checks cover off by default, off-state framing, in-process loading with the client's ABI assembly, the length and handler seams, the shard guard and strict mod.json.
